Title: Successful domestic fund transfer within available balance and daily limit
Preconditions: Customer has Checking Account #1001 with available balance $2,500.00; Daily transferred amount today is $0.00; Beneficiary Account #9988 is registered and active
Steps:
1. Navigate to /transfers/new
2. Select Source Account 'Checking #1001'
3. Select Beneficiary 'Bob Smith (#9988)'
4. Enter Amount '500.00'
5. Click 'Confirm Transfer'
Expected Result: Transfer confirmation modal displays Transaction Reference #; Checking balance updates to $1,999.50 ($500 + $0.50 fee); status 'Completed'

Title: Transfer rejected when amount exceeds available account balance
Steps:
1. Select Checking #1001
2. Enter Amount '150.00'
3. Click 'Confirm Transfer'
Expected Result: Validation error 'Insufficient funds for this transfer including $0.50 transaction fee'; Transfer blocked before debit

Title: Transfer rejected when cumulative 24-hour limit exceeds $5,000
Preconditions: Checking balance is $10,000.00; Customer has already transferred $4,500.00 within past 24 hours
Expected Result: Error alert 'Daily transfer limit exceeded. Remaining allowance for today: $500.00'; Transfer rejected

Title: Idempotency key prevents duplicate debit on rapid double-click
Preconditions: Checking balance is $1,000.00; User fills valid transfer form for $200.00
Steps:
1. Simulate double-click or simultaneous duplicate HTTP POST request with identical Idempotency-Key
2. Inspect backend transaction ledger for Checking #1001
Expected Result: Exactly ONE debit of $200.50 occurs in ledger; second request returns identical cached confirmation payload without duplicate debit

Title: Boundary value zero and negative amount rejection in UI input
Steps:
1. Attempt to input '0.00' and click Confirm
2. Attempt to input '-50.00' and click Confirm
Expected Result: Input field enforces minimum value > $0.01; 'Confirm Transfer' button remains disabled or alerts 'Amount must be greater than 0'
